## Goal
Final documentation, responsible-design notes, a compose file and the presentation slides. Also switch the default model to `qwen2.5vl:3b` (the student's decision, 2026-10-20, after F11).

**Depends on:** all
**Built by:** main session

## Acceptance criteria
### README: criterion 18 (one section each)
- [ ] the problem and responsibility of the service
- [ ] the implemented core scenario (plus the 2–4 user scenarios required as a deliverable)
- [ ] architecture and data flow
- [ ] persistence mechanism
- [ ] user interface
- [ ] API and integration points (criterion 8: REST, OpenAPI, CSV; no shared DB)
- [ ] local model and inference server
- [ ] configuration
- [ ] sandboxed agent setup (harness, model/provider, permissions, sandbox, restrictions; 0011)
- [ ] build, test and startup procedure
- [ ] known limitations

### README: "the project must document" (brief, tooling section)
- [ ] exact model name and tag; inference server and its version
- [ ] OpenAI-compatible base URL; relevant model parameters; where the prompt templates are
- [ ] expected hardware and approximate memory
- [ ] how to install, start and verify the inference server; how to obtain and start the model
- [ ] how to replace the model or the inference server
- [ ] all required environment variables
- [ ] model justification: modalities, quality, latency, memory, context length, licence, server support
- [ ] uncertainty handling (criterion 13), linking `docs/wiki/backend/uncertainty.md`
- [ ] how to get the example data for a reproducible demo (demo seed), and why the eval images aren't in the repo (privacy)

### Other deliverables
- [ ] `docs/responsible-design.md` (criterion 19): limitations, failure modes, privacy, security, misuse, how AI results are labelled
- [ ] `docker-compose.yml`: `docker compose up` starts the app (`/api/health` → `db: ok`); an optional `ollama` profile
- [ ] Decision 0030: default model `qwen2.5vl:3b` (revises 0004); config default, tests and wiki updated; host test passes
- [ ] Presentation slides covering the brief's list: problem and use case, responsibility and boundaries, architecture and decisions, persistence/UI/API, demo, the AI component, agent harness and sandbox, evaluation method and results, failures/limitations/improvements
- [ ] `make check` green; `reviewer` checks the README against this list
